text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Jalan Persekutuan

(Persimpangan Bertingkat Bandar Tasik Puteri) 2017.

1. (2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 21 Jun 2017.

Pengisytiharan jalan sebagai jalan Persekutuan

2. (1) Bahagian jalan yang dikenali sebagai Persimpangan Bertingkat Bandar

Tasik Puteri yang merupakan sebahagian daripada Lebuh Raya KL-Kuala Selangor yang

bermula dari kilometer 12.57 di koordinat U 362094.083, T 385748.822 Grid Rectified

Skew Orthomorphic (RSO) Geosentrik (GDM 2000) dan berakhir di kilometer 13.50

di koordinat U 362152.960, T 386672.156 Grid RSO Geosentrik (GDM 2000)

Lebuh Raya KL-Kuala Selangor, kedua-dua jarak diukur dari kilometer 0.00 di koordinat

U 366573.829, T 375376.712 Lebuh Raya KL-Kuala Selangor termasuk Persimpangan

Bertingkat Ijok, Plaza Tol Ijok, Persimpangan Bertingkat Puncak Alam, Persimpangan

Bertingkat Bandar Tasik Puteri, Plaza Tol Kuang Barat, Plaza Tol Kundang Timur,

Persimpangan Bertingkat Kundang, Plaza Tol Kundang Barat, Plaza Tol Kuang Timur,

Persimpangan Bertingkat Kuang, Plaza Tol Taman Rimba Templer, Persimpangan

Bertingkat Taman Rimba Templer dan jalan-jalan sambungannya dan berakhir

di kilometer 30.70 di koordinat U 364885.563, T 401792.132 Grid RSO Geosentrik

(GDM 2000), diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan.

(2) Jalan yang diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan di bawah

subperenggan (1) ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual.

FEDERAL ROADS ACT 1959

FEDERAL ROADS (BANDAR TASIK PUTERI INTERCHANGE) ORDER 2017

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 3 of the

Federal Roads Act 1959 [Act 376], the Minister, after consultation with the State

Government of Selangor, makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Bandar Tasik Puteri

Interchange) Order 2017.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 21 June 2017.

Declaration of road to be Federal road

2. (1) That part of the road known as the Bandar Tasik Puteri Interchange

which is part of the KL-Kuala Selangor Expressway commencing from kilometre 12.57

at coordinates N 362094.083, E 385748.822 of the Rectified Skew Orthomorphic (RSO)

Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid and ending at kilometre 13.50 at coordinates

N 362152.960, E 386672.156 of RSO Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid of the

KL-Kuala Selangor Expressway, both distances are measured from kilometre 0.00 at

coordinates N 366573.829, E 375376.712 of the KL-Kuala Selangor Expressway

including Ijok Interchange, Ijok Toll Plaza, Puncak Alam Interchange, Bandar Tasik

Puteri Interchange, Kuang Barat Toll Plaza, Kundang Timur Toll Plaza,

Kundang Interchange, Kundang Barat Toll Plaza, Kuang Timur Toll Plaza,

Kuang Interchange, Taman Rimba Templer Toll Plaza, Taman Rimba Templer

Interchange and its link roads and ending at kilometer 30.70 at coordinates

N 364885.563, E 401792.132 of RSO Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid, is declared to be a

Federal road.

(2) The road declared to be a Federal road under subparagraph (1) is shown

on the map in the Schedule.
